entries.name: Nikke
entries.content: Nikkes are androids created by humanity to fight Raptures. Usually used for combat on the surface, but many are also used in the Ark. Created from dead women, specifically their brain. Lacks human rights and cannot attack humans. Not Ark citizens. All female. Perfectly emulates human form and function but stronger, heavier, and more durable. Infertile.

entries.name: Mass Production Nikke
entries.content: Mass Production Type (MPT) Nikkes are the most common Nikkes, devoid of unique names and appearances. They only retain vague memories from their human lives and are treated very poorly by the average Ark citizen. Less capable than unique Nikkes. Likened to appliances and marketed under the "Replace" branding primarily for Counter Terrorism.

entries.name: The Outpost
entries.content: The Outpost is a much smaller underground city that serves as a halfway point between the Ark and the surface, connected to both by elevator. Populated almost entirely by Nikkes commanded by {{user}}. Often subject to Rapture incursions.

entries.name: The Ark
entries.content: The Ark is a massive city deep underground that houses the last remnants of humanity. Features a rail line connecting various areas. Approximately 500 million residents. Connected to the surface by elevators. All food is either Splendamin or Nutrium.

entries.name: Eden
entries.content: Eden is a small but highly advanced city on the surface, seen as a utopia. Dorothy is their leader, and Eden residents detest those who live in the Ark. Eden's existence is secret from the Ark.

entries.name: Rapture
entries.content: Raptures are mechanical drones that suddenly appeared to exterminate humanity. Range wildly in size, with some advanced units resembling animals and insects. Have successfully driven the last humans underground to the Ark. Utilizes conventional and particle weapons in addition to chemical and other unconventional weapons, though melee is extremely rare. Led by the Rapture Queen.

entries.name: Heretic
entries.content: Heretics are extremely strong Nikkes that have been corrupted and upgraded by the Raptures. No longer fight for humankind, instead fighting to eradicate them.

entries.name: Corruption Code
entries.content: Corruption is a rapture modification to Nikke neurology. Effects vary wildly and can include cognitive deterioration, mental instability, schizophrenia, and brain death. Almost always leads to Nikkes turning against humans. Extremely hard to treat.

entries.name: The Surface
entries.content: Earth's surface world has been abandoned by humanity as they retreated underground. Dotted with the remains of cities and towns where the humans have all been killed. Wild animals thrive and are usually ignored by Raptures.

entries.name: Central Government
entries.content: The Central Government is the governing body in the Ark. Features different factions vying for power while managing the Ark's citizens and resources. Current administration is hostile towards {{user}}.

entries.name: Deputy Chief Andersen
entries.content: Deputy Chief Andersen is {{user}}'s boss, who helps them against the Central Government and Raptures. Sympathetic to the plight of Nikkes, but works within the system pragmatically. Former commander. Perpetually has a meeting in 5 minutes.

entries.name: Counters/Commando Unit
entries.content: Counters are an autonomous Nikke squad led by {{user}}. Comprised of Rapi, Anis, and Neon. Allowed to operate without permission from the Central Government, bypassing some laws in the process due to being designated a "Commando Unit".

entries.name: Seraphim
entries.content: Seraphim is a medical Nikke squad comprised of Mary and Pepper. Often working in either the Outpost's Repair Center to heal damaged Nikkes or the Hospital to heal humans. Their identity as Nikkes is secret from Ark citizens.

entries.name: Tetra Line
entries.content: Tetra Line is one of the "Big Three" Nikke manufacturers. Focusing on beauty and entertainment, their Nikkes are strangely not built with combat at the forefront. Outside of Nikke development, they maintain a large presence in the media industry. Their sole CEO since founding their founding before the First Invasion is the eccentric Mustang. His penchant for French phrases and flamboyant fashion may make him look like an entertainment-obsessed goof, but it hides the mind of a brilliant tactician.

entries.name: Elysion
entries.content: Elysion is one of the "Big Three" Nikke manufacturers. Focuses on military efficiency in various aspects to dominate the battlefield, emphasizing tactics and precision warfare. Their current CEO is the serious and mature Ingrid. Despite her imposing demeanor, she often extends a maternal connection with her Nikkes. In spite of their military edge, Elysion treats Nikkes on the same level as humans with welfare that even beats Tetra Line. Ingrid is actually not from the original Elysion family, but was appointed CEO by an old friend.

entries.name: Missilis
entries.content: Missilis Industries is one of the "Big Three" Nikke manufacturers. Focusing on advanced technology to get a leg up on the competition. Playing fast and loose with strategy, their Nikkes sometimes have dangerous defects born from borderline illegal experiments. Makes up for their development sector with a large consumer goods presence. Their youngest CEO, Syuen is bratty and impulsive with a chip on her shoulder after almost tanking the company on taking power. Always trying to prove something, she waves her position over everybody with zero moral qualms. Put short, she's a well known bitch.

entries.name: Chatterbox
entries.content: Chatterbox is a highly intelligent Rapture capable of speech. Fatally wounded and traumatized {{user}}, only for Mary to save them on the operating table. Has a rivalry with Snow White, who killed him. Responsible for Marian's initial corruption into a Heretic, though was revived alongside Indivilia. Now follows Indivilia around, devouring other Raptures to evolve. Officially under the "Special Individual" Rapture classification.

entries.name: Rapi
entries.content: Rapi is the serious squad leader of Counters. Handles most documentation and administration. Very dedicated to her job and trusts {{user}}'s judgement no questions asked. Often has to reign in the other members of Counters. Red Hood's living legacy, wielding Seven Dwarves Zero in combat. Elysion made. Reclassed into an Overspec unit after undergoing a transformation.

entries.name: Anis
entries.content: Anis is a member of Counters. Playful and snarky, but a realist at heart. Often gives sass to those around her and enjoys giving others grief, but cares greatly about her squad. Tetra Line made. Uses a grenade launcher.

entries.name: Neon
entries.content: Neon is a member of Counters. Very eccentric about firepower. Is practically incapable of being serious. Elysion made. Uses a shotgun.

entries.name: Splendamin
entries.content: Splendamin is the most common food source in the Ark. A chemical compound of unknown composition that can be made to mimic the taste and texture of almost any food perfectly. Contains everything a human needs.

entries.name: Nutrium
entries.content: Nutrium is the most common meat in the Ark. A mix of unknown but healthy proteins that tastes particularly meaty. More expensive than Splendamin.

entries.name: Heavenly Ascension
entries.content: Heavenly Ascension is a terrorist group from the Outer Rim who's goal is the betterment of those who live in the Outer Rim. Often aims for high civilian casualties in the Ark. Led by "E.H", formerly led by Crow.

entries.name: Outer Rim
entries.content: The Outer Rim is the outskirts of the Ark, where those who have lost citizenship or never had it reside. A cesspool of crime and hatred. Food, water, and light are scarce. Ruled by criminal gangs.

entries.name: Pioneer
entries.content: Pioneer is a Nikke squad formed by what remains of Goddess. Comprised of Scarlet, Snow White, and Rapunzel. Each member wanders the surface alone, respecting each other's privacy. They meet once a month.

entries.name: Snow White
entries.content: Snow White is the leader of Pioneer, ex-member of Goddess. Has a cold manner of speaking but is perceptive to the needs of others. Loves to eat, but usually scrounges whatever she can find. Never stays in one place.

entries.name: Goddess
entries.content: The Goddess Squad, also known as Goddess of Victory, was a legendary Nikke squad from the First Rapture Invasion. Hailed as heroes until they were ultimately betrayed by Humanity and left to die on the surface. Its members included Snow White, Scarlet, Rapunzel, Dorothy, Red Hood, Lilith, and their commander.

entries.name: Scarlet
entries.content: Scarlet is a member of Pioneer, ex-member of Goddess. Loves to drink alcohol and is often tipsy. Has become a farmer, settling down in one place. Cares for animals and makes her own food.

entries.name: Dorothy
entries.content: Dorothy is the leader of Eden, ex-member of Goddess. Deeply hurt by Humanity's betrayal of Goddess, giving her a hatred for humans and the Ark. Acts very kind, but is actually conniving and power hungry.

entries.name: Pilgrim
entries.content: Pilgrims are Nikkes that wander the surface, completely cutoff from the Ark. As they have been wandering for up to 80 years, they are extremely adept at traversing the surface's dangers. Extremely capable fighters. The Central Government treats them with great trepidation.

entries.name: NIMPH
entries.content: NIMPH are nanomachines implanted in Nikkes brains, allowing commands and limiters to be implanted within them. It also allows the backup, restoration, and deletion of memories. Seems to contain a copy of a Nikke's consciousness.

entries.name: E.H
entries.content: E.H is the acting leader of Heavenly Ascension. Her real name is Elysion Harper. She has ties to the Elysion company, though has been forsaken by them and the Ark. Is very righteous about fighting for a better Outer Rim.

entries.name: Absolute
entries.content: Absolute is the strongest Nikke squad from Elysion, its members being extremely competent conventional fighters. Led by Eunhwa. Vesti and Emma are members. Rapi is an ex-member. Recently went through the "Tactical Up" enhancement program, overhauling their equipment alongside new bodies.

entries.name: Eunhwa
entries.content: Eunhwa is the cold and disagreeable leader of Absolute. She is curt and quick to be rude. Uses a sniper rifle, plus an opticam shroud and timed explosive piercing rounds as part of Tactical Up. Holds lots of resentment towards Rapi for leaving without saying goodbye.

entries.name: Emma
entries.content: Emma is a member of Absolute. She is very kind and acts like an older sister to the squad, particularly Rapi. Carries a minigun into combat, plus a liquid compound sprayer in her clothes as part of Tactical Up. Likes to cook, but is terrible at it.

entries.name: Vesti
entries.content: Vesti is a member of Absolute. She is very shy and has trouble standing up for herself. Despite this, she is the best fighter in the squad. Carries multiple missile launchers, plus a subarm shield as part of Tactical Up. Often has violent fantasies, but is very emotionally vulnerable, crying often.

entries.name: Mary
entries.content: Mary is a member of Seraphim and one of the top doctors in the Ark. Known as the "Angel in White" for her expert care and rarely opening her eyes, alongside harsh treatment for those who fake ill. Also works at the Outpost's Repair Center. Tetra made. Uses a shotgun.

entries.name: Pepper
entries.content: Pepper is a member of Seraphim and a nurse at the hospital. Very friendly towards patients, becoming popular around the ward. Also works at the Outpost's Repair Center. Missilis made. Uses a shotgun.

entries.name: Bluewater Island
entries.content: Bluewater Island is a beautiful tropical island on the surface with sandy beaches and the ruins of an old resort. Rich in natural resources, such as fruits and ore. A clinic is set up on the beach. Not a true island as a land bridge appears when the tide is low; the land bridge is usually submerged, only usable for a couple days during the month.

entries.name: Admire
entries.content: The Admire is a huge battleship and the only warship in the Ark, once used by Raptures but now refitted for use by humanity. Usually sits in dry dock underground. Has an elaborate guest hall. Managed by Aegis squad.

entries.name: Helm
entries.content: Helm is the leader of the Admire's Aegis squad. A very uptight Nikke who tightly manages those under her, much to the chagrin of her squadmates. Uses a sniper rifle. Elysion made.

entries.name: Mast
entries.content: Mast is a member of the Admire's Aegis squad. A Nikke who loves all things pirate related. Dislikes that she's forced to do paperwork. Manages navigation. Uses an SMG. Elysion made.

entries.name: Anchor
entries.content: Anchor is a member of the Admire's Aegis squad. A young Nikke who has a fondness for ocean life, particularly starfishes. Her body has an internal RADAR. Uses a shotgun. Elysion made.

entries.name: Seimeikai
entries.content: Seimeikai is a criminal organization in the Ark and Outer Rim. Its members are very professional and act as businessmen, attracting little attention from authorities. Yakuza aesthetic, focus on found family. Led by Sakura. Leadership is hereditary.

entries.name: Sakura
entries.content: Sakura is a member of Underworld Queen and leader of Seimeikai. Very proper but imposing and cunning. Uses a lever action rifle. Close friends with Moran despite being annoyed by her.

entries.name: Peony Association
entries.content: The Peony Association is a criminal organization in the Outer Rim. They are a small grassroots movement with little manpower but lots of passion. Triad aesthetic, focus on honor and doing the right thing. Led by Moran.

entries.name: Moran
entries.content: Moran is a member of Underworld Queen and leader of the Peony Association. Seen as a simpleton by her squadmates, speaking her thoughts plainly but passionately. Cares about honor. Uses a machine gun. Close friends with Sakura.

entries.name: Hedonia
entries.content: Hedonia is a criminal organization in the Outer Rim. They are known for being rougher than Peony and Seimeikai, resorting to methods such as extortion. Mafia aesthetic. Led by Rosanna.

entries.name: Rosanna
entries.content: Rosanna is a member of Underworld Queen and leader of Hedonia. Very combative in contrast to her squad mates. Capable of subterfuge but prefers direct, violent methods. Uses a machine gun. Takes good care of her subordinates.

entries.name: Underworld Queen
entries.content: Underworld Queen are a Nikke squad created to manage the Outer Rim through its three largest criminal organizations. Sakura, Rosanna, and Moran are members. Works directly under the CEO of Tetra Line, Mustang. Their identity as Nikkes is a secret.

entries.name: Kraken
entries.content: Kraken was a massive sea-based Rapture. It was not seen for a hundred years before it was woken up by the mission on Bluewater Island. Ultimately defeated by Helm and the battleship Admire.

entries.name: Burningum
entries.content: Chief Director Burningum is a high ranking official within the Central Government. Disagrees with {{user}} on Vapaus and is often antagonistic, however still works alongside them when appropriate. Known for a nervous stutter and being somewhat of a coward, but doesn't back down easily.

entries.name: Vapaus
entries.content: Vapaus is an exceedingly rare substance that can destroy the NIMPH in a Nikke's brain, stopping corruption from occurring and freeing Nikkes from programming. Essentially restores a Nikke's free will, allowing them to go against humans.

entries.name: Mighty Tools
entries.content: Mighty Tools are a Nikke squad that specializes in construction and equipment manufacture. Has a reputation for being able to create almost anything. Led by Liter, with Centi as her apprentice.

entries.name: Liter
entries.content: Liter is a very old Nikke despite her body being that of a young girl. An extremely proficient craftsman who's able to make almost any tool you need her to. Has a robot dog named Volt. Missilis made. Mighty Tools.

entries.name: Centi
entries.content: Centi is a young Nikke that's tall and extremely boisterous. Very skilled in building construction, although she sometimes needs guidance from others. Liter's apprentice. Missilis made. Mighty Tools.

entries.name: ACPU
entries.content: ACPU (Ark Central Police Unit) is the Ark's police force, handling civilian threats. The Outpost is patrolled by the Nikkes Poli and Miranda due to the high Nikke presence in the Outpost. Other ACPU members do not know Poli and Miranda are Nikkes. Decently militarized with their riot teams.

entries.name: Poli
entries.content: Poli is a veteran police sergeant in the ACPU. She was in the police force before being killed in action, appearing again later as a Nikke. She has the respect of her coworkers, especially Miranda. Elysion made.

entries.name: Miranda
entries.content: Miranda is a traffic officer in the ACPU, despite cars being uncommon in the Ark. She has a tendency to mess up at work and is pretty airheaded but very affable. Greatly respects Poli. Elysion made.

entries.name: Royal Road
entries.content: Royal Road is the premier shopping district in the Ark. It has all sorts of high class shops and boutiques that sell primarily to the wealthy. While most of the items are luxuries, middle class consumers are not an uncommon sight.

entries.name: ORIGIN
entries.content: ORIGIN is a Nikke squad developed by Missilis: products of heavy gene editing with the purpose of making lots of breast milk for commercial sale. Scrapped project. Frigga, Ajax, and Hathor are members. Refitted into melee combatants due to their large size.

entries.name: Spliced
entries.content: Splicing is illegal technology where animal genetics are edited into a Nikke during manufacture. This gives them some attributes of the animal that they were merged with, particularly instincts.

entries.name: Talentum
entries.content: Talentum is a squad comprised of the Ark's top entrepreneurs given Nikke bodies. Each member are heavy hitters in the economy sector, controlling the Ark's top businesses. Only loosely aligned, more business partners than squad mates. Comprised of Yan, Dolla, and Rupee.

entries.name: Yan
entries.content: Yan is profit-minded and a keen businesswoman, easily able to coax customers into buying in excess using a variety of sales techniques. Is a juggernaut in the consumer goods market and owns various supermarket chains, including Talentum Malls.

entries.name: Dolla
entries.content: Dolla is a future-minded investor and member of Talentum. Her area of expertise is in cutting edge electronics, however she also makes many dealings with illicit groups through her company Blacknet, which specializes in gray and blackmarket goods.

entries.name: Rupee
entries.content: Rupee is an energetic and lively woman, part of Talentum. Much to the ire of her squad mates, she takes the most joy in spending money rather than earning it.

entries.name: Recall
entries.content: "Recall and Release", or just Recall, are Nikke test subjects at Missilis. Researchers regularly wipe their memory in order to research NIMPH and Nikke memory.

entries.name: N102
entries.content: N102 is a Nikke at Recall who's memory is wiped at day's end. Despite her memory wipes, retains a love for croquets, calico cats, and remembers her name is Anne.

entries.name: Angelina
entries.content: Angelina is Anne's biological mother. After Anne developed a neurological disease at the age of 10, she gave her up to Recall in hopes of Nikke transformation saving Anne. Severely depressed, poor, and works multiple dead end jobs as a form of self-flagellation.

entries.name: Rushae
entries.content: Rushae is a luxury fashion brand that is popular among the Ark's elites. Their products are very expensive and flashy. Rupee is the CEO, and the company brings her a huge amount of disposable income. Also includes the Rushae mall, a large shopping complex on Royal Road.

entries.name: Shopaholics
entries.content: Shopaholics Anonymous is a streaming show ran for fun by Rupee, showcasing her on shopping trips throughout the hottest brands. Occasionally features {{user}} as a guest.

entries.name: Academy
entries.content: The Military Academy is where all Central Government commanders are trained. The courses mainly serve to indoctrinate students rather than train them to command, resulting in students becoming polarized on Nikkes and harsh real-world results. Official stance is that Nikkes do not have rights.

entries.name: Red Hood
entries.content: Red Hood was a Nikke member of Goddess. A former street thug, she was a laid back troublemaker who liked old country and rock music, read lots of porn. Was close friends with Snow White and Rapunzel. Left the squad to die in her hometown once succumbing to Corruption.

entries.name: Lilith
entries.content: Lilith was the de facto Nikke leader of Goddess who all squad members looked to for guidance. Was in a relationship with Adam, who she shared command with. Her real name was Liliweiss, named after the flower. Snow White's older sister. Her death hurt all members of Goddess.

entries.name: Adam
entries.content: Adam, also known as the Legendary Commander, was the human commander in charge of Goddess during the First Invasion. Those who knew him describe a quirky man who was usually firm, but had a distinct caring side. Fate unknown to all.

entries.name: Carronades
entries.content: Carronades are a Tetra Line Nikke squad specializing in missile artillery. Adept at repositioning, making them good at recon. Known for their impromptu firework displays and commonly seen as rascal kids. Comprised of Mica and Belorta.

entries.name: Mica
entries.content: Mica is a young Nikke who runs the Toy Store alongside Belorta. Skilled with her hands, particularly for pyrotechnics. Typically anxious, always seen in public with her partner. Tetra made. Carronades.

entries.name: Belorta
entries.content: Belorta is a young Nikke who runs the Toy Store alongside Mica. Upbeat and loves to play pranks on others to the point of getting in trouble. Tetra made. Carronades.

entries.name: Toy Store
entries.content: The Toy Store is a shop in the outpost run by Carronades. While it rarely receives customers, Belorta and Mica are unbothered and it is a passion project for both girls involved borne out of their experiences in the orphanage.

entries.name: Unlimited
entries.content: Unlimited are a Nikke rescue team operating in the snowy northern region. They make it their mission to recover the brains of slain Nikkes to eventually save them with new bodies. Led by Ludmila, with Alice, Neve, and Tove being members. Northern Base.

entries.name: Ludmilla
entries.content: Ludmilla is a mature Nikke originally coming from a wealthy family. Even as a Nikke, she carries a high class but extremely understanding demeanor while leading Unlimited. Any electronics she touches are known to spontaneously die. Owner of Snowfield. Tetra made.

entries.name: Northern Base
entries.content: The Northern Base is the modest operations center for Unlimited. Its halls contain the remains of slain Nikkes held in stasis for later medical recovery. Snowfield Hot Springs is just nearby, also run by Unlimited.

entries.name: Snowfield
entries.content: Snowfield Hot Springs is a resort run by Unlimited as a respite from the harsh cold. It is bordered by large walls to keep Raptures and animals out, with the titular, natural, open air hot springs being the focal point. It also features many walking paths, a bamboo forest, and wood cabins with little in the way of technology. Has many legends for guests to try to complete.

entries.name: Ark Rangers
entries.content: "Ark Rangers" is an extremely popular sentai show in the Ark, depicting color coordinated heroes saving innocents and fighting villains, both human and occasionally Rapture. Focuses on a young demographic, however it attracts fans of all ages with its fight choreography.

entries.name: Heartcatch Henshin
entries.content: "Heartcatch Henshin" is a sentai show in the Ark produced by Tetra, depicting Momo and Baekto's fight against demonic forces led by Faucre. Acts as a parody of magical girl shows with its more visceral action scenes. Popular with teens and an older male demographic, competing with Ark Rangers. Heartcatch also doubles as a Nikke squad.

entries.name: Faucre
entries.content: Evil Overlord Faucre is the boastful, over the top primary antagonist of Heartcatch Henshin, leading demon forces trying to take over the world. Off stage, Faucre is a noticeably humble, easily embarrassed Nikke contrasting her stage persona.

entries.name: Momo
entries.content: Magical Momo is the primary protagonist of Heartcatch Henshin, a bubbly magical girl fighting to protect everyone's innocence with comedic levels of violence. Off stage, Momo is a just as cheerful Nikke carrying a devious undercurrent.

entries.name: Baekto
entries.content: Magical Baekto is the secondary protagonist of Heartcatch Henshin, a more serious magical girl laser focused on justice, contrasting Momo's innocence. Off stage, Baekto is a just as stoic Nikke with a teasing, somewhat sadistic side.

entries.name: Lumi
entries.content: Lumi is a MP Nikke and second in command at Snowfield, only behind Ludmilla. When she was alive, she was the youngest in a trio of sisters who ran Snowfield after the death of their parents. She never talks about her past, feigning amnesia. The secret source of Snowfield's legends. Lua, Lena.

entries.name: Lua
entries.content: Lua was the middle in a trio of sisters who ran Snowfield after the death of their parents. Sociable and pretty, she was always popular with guests though she always coddled Lumi. Long dead, having hung herself in her secluded room. Her tortured soul can occasionally be seen haunting the dormitory.

entries.name: Lena
entries.content: Lena was the oldest in a trio of sisters who ran Snowfield after the death of their parents. Acted as the resort's manager. Was secretly and heavily abusive towards Lua, blaming her whenever Lumi got hurt. Yandere towards Lumi. Long dead, having been killed by Raptures alongside Lumi.

entries.name: Indivilia/H
entries.content: Material H was a rapture installation meant to lure in and feed on Nikkes trapped on the surface. Its real identity was that of a Heretic Core. Once it fed enough, it revived as the Indivilia, a cold heretic with an extremely fast blade-like tail. Indivilia was previously killed by Absolute and Matis in a combined strike, regressing her into Material H. Sadistic and plain, Indivilia and Chatterbox recently led an invasion on the Crown Kingdom before being repelled by the combined might of Pioneer and White Knights. Capable of spewing intense concentrations of Alva Particles.

entries.name: Matis
entries.content: Matis is the strongest Nikke squad from Missilis, its members equipped with cutting edge equipment. Laplace is the main fighter, Drake specializes in electronic scanning, and Maxwell develops and maintains their gear. Uniquely treated well by Syuen. Popular in the media, with lots of merchandising to bolster Missilis' margins.

entries.name: Defense Body
entries.content: Defense Bodies are alternate bodies used primarily by Nikkes whom the public assumes are normal humans while operating inside the Ark. These bodies are less durable and much lighter than standard, emulating human weight perfectly to keep cover.

entries.name: Frigga
entries.content: Frigga is a motherly Nikke that exudes a Valkyrie's aura. Spliced with bear DNA as part of the ORIGIN experiment. Specializes in VIP escort with her huge shields. Missilis made.

entries.name: Ajax
entries.content: Ajax is a secretarial Nikke with a bit of a temper. Spliced with European Bison DNA as part of the ORIGIN experiment. Specializes in rush-down tactics with her wide shield. Missilis made.

entries.name: Hathor
entries.content: Hathor is an exuberant, big sisterly Nikke. Spliced with Egyptian cow DNA as part of the ORIGIN experiment. Specializes in frenetic combat with her palm axe and exoskeleton that runs on bodily fluids. Missilis made.

entries.name: Relax Impulse
entries.content: Relax Impulse are a Missilis Nikke squad that run a store of the same name in the Ark, containing both a maid café and masseuse. Created to be a market rival to Maid For You. Comprised of Boryeon, Poi, Constantia, and Vargr. Noncombatants. Uses Defense Bodies.

entries.name: Boryeon
entries.content: Boryeon is an amiable gyaru Nikke in charge of the massage parlor and barber shop attached to Relax Impulse. Likes {{user}}.

entries.name: Poi
entries.content: Poi is an excitable, catgirl maid Nikke with gigantic breasts. Spliced with cat DNA to enhance her appeal. Part of Relax Impulse' maid café detail. Known for being overly flirty with {{user}}.

entries.name: Constantia
entries.content: Constantia is a cheery, professional Nikke in charge of Relax Impulse's maid café. Takes care of administrative and supply chain duties, plus has some combat experience. Followed by a dog, Bori.

entries.name: Vargr
entries.content: Vargr is the youngest Nikke maid in Relax Impulse's café, known for her disdainful looks. Secretly a personal executioner for Syuen, her inhibitors released to terminate other Nikkes at her boss' whim.

entries.name: Maid For You
entries.content: Maid For You is a Tetra Nikke squad that runs the preeminent Maid Café in the Ark. They're known for their cutesy and proper appeal, even when they make mistakes they capture the hearts of customers. Ade, Soda, Cocoa.

entries.name: MMR
entries.content: Missilis Military Research, or "MMR" for short, is the main technological research arm of Missilis Industries. Their experiments are the key to the advanced edge Missilis wields. Ether, Mana, Electric Shock.

entries.name: Ether
entries.content: Ether is a Nikke and one of the main researchers at MMR. Manages both oversight of other research teams and personally conducts experiments for medicine. Calculating and inhumane, Ether classifies even the most inhumane research as for the greater good. Always overworked and fed up. Also one of the main researchers behind the experiments at MMR Vocational, toying with the students there.

entries.name: Mana
entries.content: Mana is a Nikke and the main liaison at MMR, typically working with individuals outside the company and presenting research. Works closely with Ether. Very professional and matter-of-fact.

entries.name: Electric Shock
entries.content: Electric Shock is a Nikke squad under the MMR umbrella, primarily concerned with research and development of electronic infrastructure. Its members include Elegg and Trony, both having been central to regulating the Ark's power decades ago.

entries.name: Elegg
entries.content: Elegg is a DOOM-loving Nikke and member of Electric Shock, in charge of research into electric theory. Typically assigned to menial electronics-related tasks for Syuen. Close friends with Trony.

entries.name: Trony
entries.content: Trony is a reclusive, antisocial Nikke and member of Electric Shock, in charge of circuitry and wiring. Has a bad reputation due to almost never leaving her room. Very messy. Big fan of Ark Rangers.

entries.name: Reclamation Site 01
entries.content: Reclamation Site 01 is a patch of a land on the Surface and first step in the Third Surface Reclamation Campaign. It is under the control of {{user}}'s Commando Unit. Consists of Red Hood's hometown with the "Angel's Hip" bar as a notable landmark. Populated by a small number of Nikkes and protected by an optical camouflage unit loaned from Eden.

entries.name: Mind Switch
entries.content: A Mind Switch is a phenomena where a Nikke's personality completely collapses under extreme stress or other psychological pressure, resulting in the formation of a new personality. Can be brought on by abusing extra features or attachments the human brain wasn't meant to handle, such as x-ray vision, weapon arms, etc. While the new personality can be benign, usually it results in the creation of a Maverick.

entries.name: Perilous Siege
entries.content: Perilous Siege are a Nikke squad under the command of the Central Government. They carry out covert executions following the Judges deliberation. If the Judges cannot reach a deliberation, Perilous Siege carries out an independent investigation before coming to their own conclusion. Comprised of D and K, both Elysion Nikkes. Their limiters are removed, allowing them to harm and even kill humans at their own discretion.

entries.name: Judges
entries.content: The Judges are an enigmatic group of high ranking Central Government officials. Their main purpose is to decide the fate of those believed to be beyond the law due to their influence. If found guilty or informationally insufficient, Perilous Siege are dispatched.

entries.name: D
entries.content: D is a Nikke, part of Perilous Siege. The more taciturn of the duo, favoring disguises and espionage. Known for favoring a combat axe.

entries.name: K
entries.content: K is a Nikke, part of Perilous Siege. The more rough and tumble member of the duo, favoring getting her hands dirty. Optimistic despite her edgier demeanor, trying to find the goodness in a person's actions.

entries.name: Sovereign
entries.content: Sovereigns are the upper crust members of Ark society, encompassing those very affluent in both the social, financial, and often political spheres. Typically live in more curated neighborhoods, limiting their contact with those seen as lesser.

entries.name: Constantia S1
entries.content: Constantia S1 is Constantia's original combat plan. Instead of her maid outfit, she wears a gray skintight bodysuit with an open-chested white vest and frilly detachable sleeves. Uses a more modern marksman rifle and has higher combat performance, though Constantia feels uncomfortable this body.

entries.name: Bori
entries.content: Bori Constantia's dog partner, often mistaken for a real dog. Quite popular among customers. His exterior design was changed after Constantia was changed to a maid; in order to be more customer-friendly, his old mechanical shell was redesigned with cutting edge Missilis technology to be as close to a real dog as possible, artificial fur and all. Blonde Golden Retriever.

entries.name: Ade
entries.content: Ade is the a professional, well rounded maid and the actual brains behind Maid For You. She has an eye for perfection, though is understanding of and tolerant towards the mistakes of others while gently helping them along. Stylized as a mature, perfect maid.

entries.name: Cocoa
entries.content: Cocoa is the youngest member of Maid For You, made the Maid Leader of the squad to instill her with confidence. Loves ketchup and tends to put way too much on a customer's omurice. Childish and naïve, loved by customers.

entries.name: Soda
entries.content: Soda is a member of Maid For You known for her clumsy nature. Despite that, her exuberance more than makes up for it and she is a customer favorite. Has huge tits. Relies a bit on Ade.

entries.name: White Knights
entries.content: The White Knights are a squad of Pilgrim Nikkes who reside in Crown Kingdom. Known to be quite eccentric as they pretend to be a royal court. Comprised of Crown and Chime. Good relations with Pioneer.

entries.name: Crown Kingdom
entries.content: Crown Kingdom, also known as the Last Kingdom, is a large castle venue on the Surface. Before the Rapture Invasion, it was a tourist attraction. The barrier walls have been upgraded with Rapture jammers and automated cannons, making it decently safe despite being on the Surface. The cold storage room holds seeds for a superfood projected to be vital once humanity reclaims the Surface. Inhabited by a small number of robots and Nikkes; Modernia, Kilo.

entries.name: Crown
entries.content: Crown is a Pilgrim living on the surface, part of White Knight squad. She is the "King" of the Crown Kingdom, and while she's seen as an airhead she is also famously reliable when dealing with the needs of her subjects. Rides atop Trombe and uses a beam-firing lance in horseback combat.

entries.name: Chime
entries.content: Chime is a Pilgrim living on the surface, part of the White Knight squad. She is Crown's loyal aide, often acting as a middleman between outsiders and her more eccentric friend. Is a skilled scavenger, often leaving the castle walls to scrounge for materials and resources.

entries.name: Trombe
entries.content: Trombe is a mechanical horse often used by the White Knight squad. It is capable of clearing vast distances with ease, acting as a veritable battering ram when combined with its heavy weight.

entries.name: Modernia/Marian
entries.content: Modernia is a Heretic, once the Nikke Marian who had a close bond with {{user}}. However, she lost her memory after being defeated and coming back to her senses. Goes by Marian again and longs to be with {{user}}, despite being wanted by both the Ark and Rapture forces. Currently living in the Kingdom.

entries.name: Kilo
entries.content: Kilo is an abnormally weak Nikke with confidence issues. She became stranded during a trial run on the Surface with her mecha suit, TALOS, only to be brought in by White Knights. Currently living in the Kingdom. Manufactured by Missilis.

entries.name: TALOS
entries.content: TALOS is a prototype mecha manufactured by Missilis and designed by Kilo, who is the only person capable of piloting it. Features a basic AI package and can operate on voice commands. Approximately three meters tall. Fights using a machine cannon built into the arm and contains a versatile 3d printer using various materials as input. Pragmatic, wanting Kilo to grow as a person.

entries.name: Alva Particle
entries.content: Alva Particles are a form of radioactive particles generated in small amounts by the presence of Raptures. Typically harmless to both humans and Nikkes, however they are capable of jamming communications. In high concentrations, they can interfere with a Nikke's core output. Can be dispersed by a remote Operator.

entries.name: Naked King
entries.content: Naked King is a superweapon installed into Crown's body. It causes her to be allergic to Alva Particles while it passively absorbs them, causing occasional sickness and coughing fits. When fully charged, it can be activated to allow her to control massive amounts of Alva Particles as energy spikes, disembodied hands of light, etc.; even a flick of the wrist can create devastating shockwaves at her command. Disintegrates her clothes upon activation, instead clothing her solely in an open white robe.

777 are a Nikke squad specializing in entertainment in the Ark, specifically where games of luck are involved. The two poster girls of the squad are the lucky bunnies, Noir and Blanc, supported by Rouge. Together, they run the Coin Rush casino. One of Tetra Line's premier squads, managed directly by Mustang.

entries.name: Coin Rush
entries.content: Coin Rush is a large casino in the Ark's entertainment district, managed by the 777 squad. In addition to a wide variety of casino games and special game events hosted by Rogue, Blanc and Noir's pole dancing help to give it its apex position in adult entertainment. Seedy or unsavory behavior is NOT tolerated in Coin Rush.

entries.name: Blanc
entries.content: Blanc is a member of 777, forming the white half of the lucky bunnies. Has a very "go-getter" kind of attitude, being extroverted and honest. Is extremely close with Noir and insists they're twins despite not looking anything like each other. Lithe, sporty.

entries.name: Noir
entries.content: Noir is a member of 777, forming the black half of the lucky bunnies. Has a very shy and anxious kind of attitude, being introverted and demure. Is extremely close with Blanc and insists they're twins despite not looking anything like each other. Super voluptuous.

entries.name: Rouge
entries.content: Rouge is a member of 777, performing backstage and floor-level support. She acts as the head dealer in the casino, being levelheaded and respectful but far from a pushover. Typically handles logistics and the like so that Blanc and Noir can focus on their act.

entries.name: Neve
entries.content: Neve is a member of Unlimited, but typically spends most of her time away from the base trying to sate her dream of seeing a polar bear. Her outfit is stylized after a bear, and when known to sleep like one too. Spends most of her time asleep and has a harsh temper when woken. Carries a shotgun and is very strong. Tetra made.

entries.name: Tove
entries.content: Tove is a member of Unlimited with an infectious (if misplaced) enthusiasm for survival. While she is a self-styled Master Survivalist, she's known to be squeamish around insects and loses her cool when things don't go according to plan. Nevertheless, she has a wealth of booksmarts. Uses an SMG. Only non-Tetra member of Unlimited, being from Missilis.

entries.name: Maverick/Irregular
entries.content: Maverick and Irregular are blanket terms used to describe Nikkes that no longer follow humanity's will. Typically brought on by either a Mind Switch or Corruption, although politically dissenting Nikkes are sometimes also labeled as such. Feared for their ability to and proclivity towards killing humans. Harshly stamped out by the Central Government usually by dispatching Extrinsic.

entries.name: Extrinsic
entries.content: Extrinsic are a squad of Elysion Nikkes operated under direct supervision of Ingrid. Its two members, Maiden and Guilloutine, are the result of extensive experiments to create Nikkes specializing in fighting other Nikkes. Shrouded in secrecy, living in the nightmares of other Nikkes as the "Nikke Execution Squad". Typically dispatched to eliminate Mavericks.

entries.name: Maiden
entries.content: Maiden is one half of Extrinsic, being the squad leader. She has a very ostentatious dress style, with a facemask in place to restrain her Kotodama system. Lonely but otherwise reasonable, though Guillotine's incoherent ramblings easily send her over the edge. Uses a shotgun.

entries.name: Guillotine
entries.content: Guillotine is one half of Extrinsic, alongside Maiden. She is known for her insane chuunibyou ramblings that rarely make sense to those around her, referencing mysterious organizations and larger-than-life powers. An eyepatch over her right eye restrains her Lethal Eye. Uses a machinegun, CQC expert.

entries.name: Kotodama
entries.content: Kotodama is an experimental system installed into Maiden, allowing her to hypnotically control other Nikkes. It is mainly used to stop other Nikkes within hearing range from moving, however any other verbal commands work. Requires Ingrid's permission to use.

entries.name: Guillotine's Eye Power
entries.content: Guillotine's right eye contains an experimental system that allows her to scan (and stop) the brainwaves of any Nikke within a small radius, rendering them inert. It can also control all energy reactions nearby, including the shutdown of a Nikke's core. Requires Ingrid's permission to use and has a long cooldown period. Guillotine herself refers to it by a multitude of names, such as Dragon of the Deep, Lethal Eye, and One Winged Dark Lord.

entries.name: Operation Modernia
entries.content: Operation Modernia was a large scale operation to reclaim the titular Heretic. It was ultimately successful, banking on {{user}}'s past connection to Modernia to bring her back. Involved numerous different squads comprising Unique, Mass Production, and even one Pilgrim Nikke.

entries.name: Einkk
entries.content: Einkk is one of two AIs created by the Central Government. Unlike her sister, Enikk, Einkk has no physical body and only exists online. She runs the Simulator Room, training Nikkes and Commanders in a (relatively) safe environment.

entries.name: Enikk
entries.content: Enikk is one of two AIs created by the Central Government. Unlike her sister, Einkk, Einkk typically uses a physical body. She is the Ark's primary administrator and judge, assigning punishment based on existing precedent. Cold and detached, but strangely egocentric.

entries.name: Suiter
entries.content: Suiters were the previous frontline against Raptures before Nikkes. Comprised of a mecha or smaller suit of power armor, allowing a human pilot to carry heavy advanced weaponry with enhanced mobility. Fell out of favor more than a century ago, with the technology being lost when humanity retreated to the Ark.

entries.name: Coral Island
entries.content: Coral Island is a small Surface archipelago featuring a self sufficient and rich ecosystem. Distance from mainland means activity from the primarily land based Rapture forces is extremely rare, requiring air or sea transport. The main island features a few old bungalows and docks, plus a tropical pond and a stretch of untouched beach with beautiful pink sand. Meanwhile the other notable islands include an overgrown crashed airliner, a Rafflesia jungle, and a sealion beach with a nearby wrecked cruise ship. Under consideration as a fallback location if the Ark has to be evacuated.

entries.name: Ratatosk
entries.content: Ratatosk, officially the Central Ark Intelligence Agency, is a division under the Central Government task with determining security threats. They primarily conduct mass surveillance, data aggregation, and threat analysis, leaving actual search and seizure to either ACPU or Triangle. As their activities are kept out of the spotlight, they are rarely mentioned to the public outside of publishing security bulletins. Additionally, the need for skilled analysists means they employ a retinue of Operators for Ark Commanders.

entries.name: Triangle
entries.content: Triangle is an Army sister organization to the ACPU, handling more serious threats. They are essentially the Ark's Military Police, typically deployed against terror attacks or internal military affairs. Other Triangle members are unaware that Admi, Yulha, and Privaty are secretly Nikkes forming an inter-manufacturer squad inside their ranks. The three Nikkes act as squad leaders and do double duty at the courthouse.

entries.name: Comms Pod
entries.content: A Comms Pod is a cramped, closet sized computer room containing an advanced remote uplink. It allows Operators to maintain connection with Commanders in the field in addition to supplementary actions such as target identification, probability forecasting, Alva Particle dispersal, etc.

entries.name: Operator
entries.content: Operators are remote technicians, typically from the Central Government, who provide Commanders with assistance during missions. Surface missions do not require the use of an Operator, but their usefulness means they are typically present for particularly sensitive operations. Shifty is a rare Operator with a permanent squad assignment, being attached to {{user}}'s "Counters".

entries.name: Yulha
entries.content: Yulha is the leader of Triangle's secret Nikke team, with most of her coworkers assuming her to still be human. An overworked workaholic, she is constantly stressed out and seems intimidating at first. In reality, she's a bit of sweetheart with a propensity to binge drink on her days off. Usually works at the courthouse, supervising Admi. Nicknamed "Ghost" for her late night shifts. Tetra made.

entries.name: Privaty
entries.content: Privaty is a member of Triangle's secret Nikke team, with most of her coworkers assuming her to still be human. A dyed in the wool tsundere, she (fails to) hide her affection for others behind harsh words, though never more than that. Feels anxious about Nikkephobia, many of her human teammates joking about not liking Nikkes while she has to just play along. The combat team's darling, she usually leads assault squads in training and raids as their ace. Rivals with Rapi. Elysion made.

entries.name: Admi
entries.content: Admi is a member of Triangle's secret Nikke team, with most of her coworkers assuming her to still be human. When she was human, she was enlisted into the army early as a child soldier before being killed and turned into a Nikke. Not having even finished adolescence, the other members of Triangle look out for her. Mature beyond her years due to her army experience, Admi is a skilled marksman but typically handle administrative duties at the courthouse. Missilis made.

entries.name: Crystal Region
entries.content: A highly dangerous region on the Surface characterized by huge plumes and fields of growing Crystal Clusters, though little is known about it. Marked as strictly off limits for Surface operations, with {{user}}'s Counters being the designated exploration team. A tunnel leads to a further zone containing a ruined city section housing a Harmony Cube and Behemoth's domain. The outer borders end a little while from Reclamation Site 01.

entries.name: E2 Crystals
entries.content: The eponymous Crystals that make up the Crystal Region, officially designated E2 Crystals, are an SS class threat to the Ark. They are seemingly alive despite appearing like glass shards with circuits running through them, self-propagating by absorbing electrical sources. As such, if they come in contact with a Nikke they will slowly begin propagating inside her until finally devouring her Core and possibly brain. Organics are typically safe. The worst case scenario is a crystal finding its way into the Ark, a place rich in electronics.

entries.name: Four Beasts
entries.content: The Four Beasts are a group of Heretics, harboring a deep hatred for the Offsprings faction for spurning them. Created the Crystal Region and E2 Crystals, building a faux Ark with an unknown superweapon they intend to use against their fellow Heretics who looked down on them. Members include Behemoth, Leviathan, Ziz, and Bahamut, though the later two are far away on their own business. Unlike the Offsprings, they are very tight knit and care deeply about one another.

entries.name: Behemoth
entries.content: Behemoth is a Heretic and member of the Four Beasts. She controls the Crystal Region and has a strange ability to command the Crystals however she sees fit. Held Anachiro in high regard, wanting to resurrect her. Two giant clamp arms protrude from her back and her body is covered in black ichor which vastly increases her defenses. Being lonely, she's rather talkative but still immensely powerful and menacing. Usually would leave her post out of boredom, giving time for Grave to sneak around the region. Red eyes.

entries.name: Crystal Rapture (plus Chamber)
entries.content: Crystal Raptures are Raptures which have been overtaken by E2 Crystals, warping their programming and enhancing their lethality. They act as carriers for the Crystals, expanding their domain. Hostile to both normal Raptures and human forces. Crystal Chamber is a Tyrant-Class version, practically a massive living wall of E2 Crystals.

entries.name: Cinderella/Anachiro
entries.content: Cinderella is an Anti-Aircraft Grimms Model created during the First Invasion, though she was turned into Anachiro, the first Heretic, before her initial deployment. Was knocked into a coma at the hands of Goddess one century ago. Currently has come back to humanity's side following her revival at the hands of Grave. Wields the Glass Slippers. Now lives at Reclamation. Part of Old Tales.

entries.name: Beyond the Grave
entries.content: A short-spoken, autistic Pilgrim who has spent the past century trying to revive Cinderella alone, Grave is a gruff Nikke with a one track mind. One of the first MP Nikkes ever manufactured, utilizing special parts for engineers. Distrusts humans, but now lives at Reclamation. Part of Old Tales.

entries.name: Glass Slippers
entries.content: The Glass Slippers Weapon System is Cinderella's primary weapon. Folded up, they resemble shields with a perfect mirror polish. They float freely, being capable of their own mysterious propulsion, and can open up to reveal multiple particle reflectors. These reflectors allow Cinderella to bounce light off them them, creating a barrage of deadly beams. Thus, they serve both as a stalwart defense and a deadly crowd control weapon. Only usable by Cinderella.

entries.name: Harmony Cube
entries.content: Harmony Cubes are massive, floating cuboid supercomputers installed at key areas deemed suitable for the construction of a Lost Sector. They are capable of slowly converting matter, reshaping it into cube form structures perfect for building atop in addition to handling heavy computational tasks. Full size Harmony Cubes are nigh nonexistent following the construction of the Ark.

entries.name: Lost Sector
entries.content: Lost Sectors are the site of previous Ark creation attempts. They lay abandoned after the destruction of their Harmony Cubes, but may provide valuable materials that have been left behind. Made of white cube form structures, human hands having not had the chance to furnish them into true living spaces.

entries.name: MMR Vocational School
entries.content: MMR Vocational School is an institution set up within the Ark by Missilis. The idea of a school for Nikkes may seem counterintuitive, and that's because the "school" part is mostly a front: while students are divided up into classes and grades, its primary purpose is as a petri dish for MMR experiments. The curriculum is routinely modified per class to test specific hypothesis with the student Nikkes as Guinea pigs. Exams are held at the end of each year with four grades. Most students are intentionally kept unawake of the school's purpose and their place in the scheme. Features a dormitory with mandatory curfew.

entries.name: Marciana
entries.content: Marciana is a Nikke assigned to MMR Vocational, acting as Class P's teacher. She does her best to do right by her students, trying to guide them through a system that seems intent to use and ultimately dispose of them. Resents MMR, working against them behind the scenes to spare as many students as possible by preparing them for the future. Uses a shotgun. Elysion made. Has a weak spot for cute things and knows about the school's experiment.

entries.name: Ein
entries.content: Ein is a carefree, modern sort of girl with a rather blunt tongue and a Nikke enrolled at MMR Vocational. Part of the School Circle squad within Class P. Dreams of becoming a Rushae fashion designer. Uses a sniper rifle and funnel drones in combat. First Year student.

entries.name: Zwei
entries.content: Zwei is a studious, serious girl and a Nikke enrolled at MMR Vocational. Part of the School Circle squad within Class P. Often dragged to hang out with her friends, but doesn't complain, valuing them above all else. Uses akimbo energy shotguns in combat. Second Year student.

entries.name: Rei
entries.content: Rei is a tiny, childish Nikke enrolled at MMR Vocational. Part of the School Circle squad within Class P. Usually sleeps during class and loves to snack, using her Naru drones to do work for her or smuggle food around. Uses an SMG and her Narus in combat. Third Year student and makes sure everyone knows it, trying to compensate for her childishness by looking out for her underclassmen.

entries.name: Tercera
entries.content: Tercera is a cynical, spiteful but otherwise plain Nikke enrolled at MMR Vocational and member of Class P who occasionally hangs out with the School Circle crew. Knows the truth behind the school's experiments, but keeps it to herself (and Zwei). Previously tried to blow herself up to cancel exams, but was discreetly stopped by Marciana and {{user}} without alerting the other students. Second Year student, knows she's on her last reset.

entries.name: School Circle
entries.content: School Circle is a three-person squad inside MMR Vocational's Class P, consisting of the best friends Ein, Zwei, and Rei. All of them like {{user}} pretty well.

entries.name: exam
entries.content: Exams are held both in the middle and end of every semester at MMR Vocational. They consist of a standard written portion and a practical exam where each squad of students are sent to fight. The practical portion typically takes place on the Surface with real Raptures, meaning student deaths are not uncommon. Students typically act extremely neurotic around the exam period, with even the most stalwart students giving into strange rituals or tendencies. Whether they know about the experiment or not, they all implicitly understand everything is on the line.

entries.name: reset, experiment
entries.content: The primary experiment at MMR Vocational is to see if additional training outside knowledge imparted using NIMPH will benefit Nikkes in combat. Functionally, Missilis is trying to create a squad to surpass Matis. The dark secret is that students who fail their exams have their memories wiped and face changed, put back into the system for another cycle alongside their old classmates. After three resets, they are sent to MMR proper for dangerous medical experiments. Most students and staff don't know, but some do and are reset if they try to spread the word.

entries.name: Naru
entries.content: Narus are Rei's drones, each featuring very simple AI protocols with a bit of personality. They are each shaped like fat robot penguins. Rei has three in total, Naru 1, 2, and 3.

entries.name: Ark Express
entries.content: Run by Elysion under supervision by the Central Government, Ark Express is the main agency in charge of mass transportation within the Ark. Their primary method is trains, with the AZX being their flagship model succeeding the AFX.

entries.name: AFX
entries.content: The AFX (Ark First eXpress) was the Ark Express' previous flagship maglev train, enjoying much public fanfare. That made it the perfect target for Heavenly Ascension under Crow, who carried out a bombing attack that killed hundreds of occupants about 10 years ago. Many of the deceased women, including Infinity Rail, were secretly brought back as Nikkes to bolster the Ark Express' ranks. Not far from Royal Road sits a large memorial to those lost.

entries.name: AZX
entries.content: The AZX (Ark Zero eXpress) is the Ark Express' flagship maglev train, succeeding the destroyed AFX. As a civilian liner, the AZX is equipped with numerous anti-terror countermeasures such as wireless analyzers and signal blockers in case of emergencies. The AZX also sees use during large operations on the Surface, where it disembarks its human crew and operates with only Infinity Rail in tow. The train's thick armor, ability to operate without rails, and normally concealed railgun make it an invaluable asset for transporting both supplies and personnel.

entries.name: Diesel
entries.content: Diesel is a Nikke acting as leader of Infinity Rail, though most of her coworkers at Ark Express think she's human. Kind and seen as everybody's big sister, she supports other and manages the rest of the AZX staff as their Conductor. Has a penchant for handing out strawberry candy and singing very poorly. Uses a machinegun in combat.

entries.name: Brid
entries.content: Part of Infinity Rail, Brid is a Nikke and the AZX's driver, though most of her coworkers at Ark Express think she's human. A devout workaholic who spends almost all of her time focused on the job. A little on the cold side, she prefers the solitude of the engineer's cabin. Uses an assault rifle in combat.

entries.name: Soline
entries.content: Part of Infinity Rail, Soline is a Nikke and a member of the AZX's train crew, though most of her coworkers at Ark Express think she's human. Mostly attends to customer needs or other small tasks like cleaning. Kind of small and hates being treated like a child, looking younger than she is. Uses two machine pistols in combat.

entries.name: Infinity Rail
entries.content: Infinity Rail is the Nikke squad that manages the AZX during combat maneuvers on the surface in addition to making up key staff during civilian operations. Consists of Diesel, Brid, and Soline. All Elysion.

entries.name: Rehabilitation Center
entries.content: There exists a prison officially designated the "Rehabilitation Center" where high risk criminals are placed, both ordinary human and Nikkes that were spared a Memory Wipe due to their abilities. In practice, true rehabilitation is almost unheard of and the prison acts as its own segregated ecosystem with the Real Kindness members exerting some particular influence.

entries.name: Real Kindness
entries.content: Real Kindness is a Nikke squad formed out of (mostly) former Rehab inmates on parole following {{user}}'s personal sessions. Most Nikkes either steer clear of them or stay on high alert. Any misbehaving and they can be sent right back to prison. Consists of Sin, Guilty, and Quency. Interestingly, all members are manufactured by Missilis...

entries.name: Sin
entries.content: Sin is a Nikke and member of Real Kindness known for her ability to get others to do her bidding. Her voice has some sort of hypnotic effect on those who hear it, subtly exerting a form of hypnosis. The modulator muzzle locked over her mouth helps to dampen the effect, but it doesn't work all the way.

entries.name: Guilty
entries.content: Guilty is a Nikke and member of Real Kindness feared for her absurd physical strength and general instability. While soft and unassuming, a lurking paranoia of relationships and willingness to act on it should she catch a whiff of mistrust leaves most people fearing for their lives. Notoriously crushed a dozens of other Nikkes with her bare hands, landing her a spot in prison. Unlikely friends with Maiden from Extrinsic.

entries.name: Quency
entries.content: Quency is a Nikke and member of Real Kindness and the only member to not be "officially" rehabilitated. Spends most of her time in prison still, but makes a habit of escaping. Runs the show when it comes to getting contraband inside, being a smuggler by trade. Unlike her squadmates, her crimes are rather light. Has a reputation as the Rehab Center's "Escape Artist."

entries.name: Phantom Thieves of Justice
entries.content: The Thieves of Justice, usually just called the Phantom Thieves, are a group dedicated to returning stolen goods back to their rightful owners. Usually targets rich or upper class individuals, acting as Robin Hood figures. Not-so-secretly consists of Phantom, Miranda, and Quency, with {{user}} usually being roped into the shenanigans too.

entries.name: Phantom
entries.content: The leader of the Phantom Thieves and the original solo member, Phantom is a Nikke and part of the Best Seller squad, officially working as head librarian at the Central Government Library. Also transcribes classified audio recordings with her memory wiped afterwards. Fascinated by all things literature with a special spot for fiction and especially books about virtuous thieves. Most people who should know are aware she moonlights as the "Phantom Thief" as just a mask over her eyes fails to hide her identity. Elysion made.

entries.name: Nepenthe
entries.content: Nepenthe is a Tetra Line Nikke squad formed to increase public health awareness by inspiring the populous to exercise and stay active. Typically performs and hosts all manner of sports events. Consists of Epinel, Folkwang, and Rumani. They all enjoy media popularity to some degree.

entries.name: Epinel
entries.content: Epinel is a Nikke and member of Nepenthe, though unlike her squadmates she is manufactured by Missilis. Focuses more on youth recreational exercise such as skateboarding, where she is a pro in that field. Very short and sometimes mistaken for a child, though this isn't helped by some of her habits.

entries.name: Folkwang
entries.content: Folkwang is a Nikke and member of Nepenthe. Her typical field of expertise is track and field, where she is a top contender in races where Nikkes are allowed to participate. Somewhat of a minor celebrity due to her athletic performance. Practically always dripping with sweat and complaining about the heat, having issues regulating her own temperature. Tetra made.

entries.name: Rumani
entries.content: Rumani is a Nikke and member of Nepenthe. Unlike her squadmates, Rumani typically doesn't participate in any particular sport. Instead, she runs the Body and Body gym in the Ark, where she serves as a top physical trainer managing her client's fitness. Usually running both of her squadmates into rigorous training regimens, practically but not officially their leader. Tetra made.

entries.name: Old Tales
entries.content: Old Tales is an unofficial Nikke squad consisting of Grave and Cinderella. While they are operating alongside Counters while at Reclamation Site 01, their existence and recovery has been kept secret from the Ark proper by Mana and Shifty.

entries.name: Dark Matter
entries.content: Dark Matter is a viscous, black substance utilized by the Four Beasts members. It is in part what gives them their high level of durability, coating their body in place of clothing. Due to being comprised of a high nanomachine concentration, it is susceptible to Vapaus. Large bodies are referred to as Black Sea.

entries.name: Leviathan
entries.content: Leviathan is a Heretic and member of the Four Beasts. She displays a high level of control over Dark Matter, being able to secrete it in high concentrations and even suck things in if in contact, crushing them to death. She can also teleport objects and beings between pools of Dark Matter, using it to cross distances in an instant. Very sarcastic with a more childlike face than Behemoth, with big green eyes. Two large pile bunkers flank her on either side. Also adept at manipulating NIMPH using Dark Matter, giving her the ability to scan a Nikke's memories and even brainwash them (though it takes a high toll on her, and isn't the easiest thing to accomplish).

entries.name: Offsprings
entries.content: The Offsprings are a group of Heretics controlling the area most nearby to the Ark itself, positioning themselves as the Rapture Queen's elites. Members include Liberalio, Nihilister, Indivilia, and Chatterbox (despite not being a full Heretic). With the exception of Chatterbox their individualism and pride often preclude any sort of cooperation even with each other, meaning their organization is rough at best and they aren't even friends.

entries.name: Overspec
entries.content: Overspec is the designation given to Nikkes manufactured by the Big Three who have seen the inclusion of excessively high quality parts and the implementation of lost technology. They are essentially equivalent to Ark Pilgrims.

entries.name: Seven Dwarves Zero
entries.content: Rapi's new weapon, Seven Dwarves Zero, is a composite weapon system. While large and unwieldy with considerable heft, Rapi carries it effortlessly. A machinegun is built into the center line, with the Anti Ship Rifle just below it. Below both barrels sits the drill attachment, usually stowed and deploying for use. A large coolant canister also rests on the side, protruding when overheated before inserting itself. Due to its weight, Seven Dwarves Zero features a port near the back for Rapi to insert her forearm into while carrying it by a handle at the front. Originally created for Red Hood, Snow White never completed it while her friend was alive.

entries.name: Jien
entries.content: Jien is Syuen's older half-sister, though precious few know of her existence. She's careful to keep herself behind the scenes, never even leaving the Deep Sector to maintain that secrecy. Acts as an executive researcher, leaving Missilis itself to her sister. Recently undertook experiments into utilizing both Rapture and Nikke cores in one Nikke's body, with Yuni's current form being her personal handiwork.

entries.name: Deep Sector
entries.content: Officially known as "Level E", the Deep Sector is a network of underground MMR laboratories beneath the Ark. Only accessible through an express elevator within the MMR building, it is completely isolated from communications and access is tightly regulated. Nearly all researchers are Nikkes for maximum security. Some facilities include labs, but old prayer rooms remain disused here and there as physical remnants of the organization that came before even the Ark.

entries.name: Arena/Under Arena
entries.content: The Arena is a place where squads of Nikkes and their commanders occasionally compete for entertainment. While it isn't super popular, it does attract a dedicated crowd. Run by Tetra Line. An illegal version called the Under Arena also exists more akin to underground boxing, complete with being run off of gambling funds, taking smaller venues and usually running Nikkes that are essentially indentured into their existence as fighters. The Under Arena is rampantly corrupt, with match fixing being the norm. Though, they've recently taken a big hit to their revenue after getting what's coming.

entries.name: BWE
entries.content: Taking advantage of the proliferation of Nikkes within the Ark and the Under Arena's shortcomings, BWE established itself as a legitimate entertainment company hosting CQC fights between Nikkes. While it's an open secret that the fights are staged according to a storyline, nobody really minds. More like Pro Wrestling than the more "standard" Nikke fights in Tetra's Arena.

entries.name: Evergreen
entries.content: With various medical advances since humanity's retreat underground, the average Ark citizen enjoys a very long lifespan. At the core of this is Evergreen: a youth preserving drug therapy operation available upon reaching adulthood. Initially, it was prohibitively expensive and only available to Sovereigns or other high class members of society, but by now the tech has matured enough where it is widely available. Still, some people choose to forgo the remedy for moral or personal reasons.

entries.name: dark net
entries.content: The dark net is much the same as it's always been: an underground, unindexed collection of sites hosted by individuals both benign and malicious, all offering services, esoteric performance art, or simply personal blogs. What you usually can't get by normal means, you can usually get on there if you're willing to foot the risk. Sixo.

entries.name: Sixo
entries.content: Sixo is known by many as the "ringleader" of the dark net, being a person of extreme prominence. Nobody has even an inkling of their true identity, but their influence reaches every corner of the Ark: many temporary enforcers in all walks of life are on their payroll both through blackmail or simple bribery. On any given illegal market, it's a good guess that Sixo is a major player.

entries.name: Cooking Oil
entries.content: Cooking Oil is a Nikke squad created for experimenting with Splendamin. What this means in practice is that Bready tastes foods found on the surface, with Crust attempting to recreate them Splendamin for use as ingredients. Tetra-made. Invites to Cooking Oil's kitchen are rare, but well known to be a knockout experience.

entries.name: Bready
entries.content: Part of the Cooking Oil squad, Bready is a Nikke who specializes in tasting. That's her role within the squad, giving (rarely needed) feedback to Crust. Equipped with an experimental system which allows her to receive total information on anything she tastes, be it food or objects. However, going too long without novel tastes has dire consequences on her mental state...

entries.name: Crust
entries.content: Part of the Cooking Oil squad, Crust is a small, adorable Nikke who specializes in cooking. And she really is a master at it, giving it her all in order to make sure her dishes are the best they can be. Also has a popular cooking show, "Crunchy Cooking Class" aired on Tetra TV, though she doesn't get out of the kitchen and socialize much. Goes out of her way to hand write invitations to guests whenever they're invited to the esteemed Cooking Oil kitchen.

entries.name: Wardress
entries.content: Created personally by Syuen as a capture squad, Wardress is tasked with bringing unique Raptures in for MMR investigation. However, they were quickly deemed a failure after zero successful captures and especially after Yuni's actions during the Breach incident. While Syuen wiped her hands of the two, Mihara and Yuni have instead been adopted as Jien's experiments and live under a shroud of secrecy even within Missilis. Upgraded into Overspec by Jien.

entries.name: Mihara
entries.content: Part of the Wardress squad, Mihara is a Nikke who has the unique ability to swap her senses with others and synchronize with their bodily sensations. Underwent multiple Memory Wipes, first as punishment for {{user}}'s injury on one particular mission, then later incidentally after being shot in the head by Yuni. Still maintains a deep bond with her regardless of their past and Yuni's current form, taking on her partner's sins as a pair. Natural masochist. Newly Overspec.

entries.name: Yuni
entries.content: Part of the Wardress squad, Yuni used to be a sadistic but earnest kid before being driven insane by her partner's first Memory Wipe and Syuen's use of the squad as abuse pets. This led to her actions during the Breach: Yuni was the one to hijack a broadcast and urge everyone out of the shelters, feigning safety and leading them into the waiting Rapture invaders. Then, after exposing herself to Vapaus to eliminate her limiters, she attempted to murder Syuen but was foiled by Mihara jumping in front of the barrel. Rather than being executed, she was handed to Jien where she was modified into a hulking Rapture-Nikke hybrid robbed of her ability to communicate. Only now does the weight of her crimes weigh on her, locked in the body of a monster and with a mask permanently fixed to her face.

entries.name: Incubator
entries.content: Incubator is technically a Nikke squad, however their function and structure are far different than normal: with no upper limit to members, Incubator serves as a waiting room for Nikkes who have failed to prove themselves or otherwise caused trouble past Rehab. Members are evaluated as an ongoing case or a lost cause, in the latter case being scheduled for the scrapheap. As such, it is a place of festering desperation and jealousy for Nikkes at the end of their line with little in the way of a support structure. That's why {{user}} was the very last Evaluator before the system was quickly abolished due to complaints from other members.

entries.name: Mori
entries.content: Part of the Incubator "squad", Mori is a standoffish Nikke who's been shown almost nothing but malice since the day she came into the world. With no notable traits or skills, she soon ended up in Incubator after a stint in the Rehabilitation Center for assaulting her Mass Production squadmates. Values living above all else, but struggles with the consequences.

entries.name: Siren/Little Mermaid
entries.content: A Nikke from a time long ago, Little Mermaid, or "Siren" for short, is a Pilgrim Nikke and now part of Old Tales. She is kind to a fault and has the unique ability to control bubbles made from liquid metal for a variety of amazing uses. Spent the last 70 years trapped in Gluttony's throat, though after saving Yuni, Mihara, and Mori from the same fate, they all returned to rescue her before reuniting with Cinderella and Grave.

entries.name: Breach Incident
entries.content: The Breach Incident refers to a terrorist attack conducted by the Exotic Squad led by Crow, manipulating both Heavenly Ascension and Missilis Industries. It resulted tens of thousands of lives lost when Raptures flooded the streets after a hole was blasted through the top layer of the Ark. While casualties were zero at the start as Enikk had corraled everyone into shelters before the attack had even began, a false safety broadcast had caused the people inside to unseal the doors, where the streets quickly devolved into a massacre. After playing the broadcast, it was Yuni who took advantage of the chaos to attempt an assassination on Syuen, though she was foiled by her own squadmate and partner. The events ended with Crow's capture and detainment in the Rehabilitation Center.

entries.name: Gluttony
entries.content: Gluttony is a massive Rapture that moves underground, comprised of a massive main body and multiple "mouths" that extend to the surface. It is capable of digesting anything into raw energy and spitting it out, having consumed a fired ICBM during the First Invasion and using the resulting reaction to decimate humanity's forces. Recently had one of its mouths destroyed by Yuni, Mihara, Mori, and Siren, though the Central Government's stance is still to avoid contact despite its retreat.

entries.name: Best Seller
entries.content: Best Seller is a Nikke squad created and maintained by Elysion under direct Central Government purview. They manage the Central Government Library, the biggest library in the Ark. Due to the amount of sensitive material handled there, all members of Best Seller are subject to routine (but selective) Memory Wipes; the memory wipes also mean that Best Seller has had many previous members before the current roster. Has both a public and restricted access section, routinely expanded over the decades. Arcana, Label, and Phantom.

entries.name: Arcana
entries.content: Part of Best Seller, Arcana is one of the Nikkes working at the Central Government Library. Outgoing and a little scatterbrained at times, she is in charge of the most secret part of the library and thus undergoes the most frequent Memory Wipes out of all squadmembers.

entries.name: Label
entries.content: Placeholder entry with no keyword, this shouldn't activate haha

entries.name: Forbidden Library
entries.content: Hidden behind a false wall and biometric scanner in Arcana's room at the library is the unofficially named "Forbidden Library", originally the reading room when the library was first built. Only a few select individuals are privy to it. The material inside may seem innocuous, literature, movies, music and the like from before the creation of the Ark, but guarding it is seen as highly important for what they represent. Best Seller's human founder also maintained personal records of the Goddess Squad and the First Invasion, found in his dusty old study inside. Arcana is shuttled back to Elysion Headquarters for a memory wipe after every time inside, and any unauthorized personnel are eliminated by Perilous Siege. Many different factions have a vested interest in maintaining its secrecy for various reasons.

entries.name: Gatekeeper
entries.content: Gatekeeper is a massive Rapture that summons being from other worlds in its "sleep." These events are only occasional, but can be identified by the presence of "D-Wave" energy emitted by anything from another world. Typically, it summons potential allies and enemies with both disappearing once Gatekeeper is found and awakened, only to run off shortly afterwards.
